header.title: InputText
header.description: Base text field for gem-system: label, helper text, error, prefix and suffix, status borders and regex validation. InputSearch, InputPassword and InputMask are built on top of it.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Try the main props and copy the generated code.

outlineLabel.description: `labelPlacement="outline"` places the label on the top border.

texts.label: Full name

withInfoIcon.title: With info icon
withInfoIcon.description: `infoText` adds an icon with a tooltip at the top-right.

texts.label: Full name
texts.helperText: The info control sits at the top-right when infoText is set.

withInfoReactNode.title: Info with ReactNode
withInfoReactNode.description: `infoText` accepts any React node for custom tooltip content. `infoLabel` gives the icon its accessible name.

validRegex.description: `validRegex` shows the error border when the value does not match. `onValidate` reports validity to the parent.

outlineLabelBorders.title: Outline label borders

withPrefixIcon.title: With prefix icon
withPrefixIcon.description: `prefixIcon` adds a decorative icon before the value.

withSuffixIcon.title: With suffix icon
withSuffixIcon.description: `suffixIcon` adds a decorative icon after the value.

withPrefixAndSuffix.description: Use both at once. The input padding adapts to the width of each.

texts.label: Amount

error.title: Error
error.description: `errorMessage` shows the message with role="alert" and forces the error border.

uppercase.title: Uppercase

texts.label: Code

borders.title: Borders
borders.description: `border` sets the tone of the border and helper text. Forced to error when the field is invalid.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Three sizes: sm, md and lg.

styleOverrides.title: Style overrides
styleOverrides.description: `className` targets the <input>, `wrapperClassName` the container and style is passed inline to the <input>.

className.helperText: Rounded secondary look from a consumer class.

wrapperClassName.helperText: Label and control restyled from the wrapper.

style.helperText: Useful for one-off tweaks without a CSS class.

allStates.title: All states
allStates.description: Base, with icons, error and disabled.

tailwind.brandHelper: Secondary accent and pill shape with cn() on wrapperClassName.
tailwind.mergedHelper: radius-xs replaces radius-full thanks to tailwind-merge.

css.label: Soft field
css.helperText: No border, soft tertiary background and lg radius, tokens only.

header.title: InputText API
header.description: API reference for the InputText React component: props, events, CSS classes, variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demos page.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from the main entry or from its subpath to load only this component.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: It accepts native <input> attributes (InputHTMLAttributes) except size, prefix and type, which are redefined. Extra attributes, className and style go to the <input>; wrapperClassName goes to the container.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.label: The label is linked to the input with htmlFor. Without a visible label, pass aria-label.
a11y.describedby: helperText and errorMessage are linked with aria-describedby; the error uses role="alert".
a11y.states: isInvalid and isRequired map to aria-invalid and aria-required. The asterisk is aria-hidden.
a11y.info: The info icon is a button with a tooltip; infoLabel gives it an accessible name when infoText is not text.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can target to override styles.

rules.label: Field label.
rules.field: Container for the input and the prefix and suffix slots.
rules.message: Helper or error text below the field.
rules.hasPrefix: Applied when there is a prefix.
rules.hasSuffix: Applied when there is a suffix.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: The component computes them by measuring the prefix and suffix, applied as inline style on the root. Read them from your CSS; a class cannot override them.

items.--gem-input-prefix-pad: Measured prefix width; used as the input left padding.
items.--gem-input-suffix-pad: Measured suffix width; used as the input right padding.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: gem-system tokens used by the field. Redefine them in your `wrapperClassName` to change only this field.

items.--gem-color-accent: Focus border and outline label on focus.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

items.type: Native input type, restricted to text-like values.
items.placeholder: Placeholder text when the field is empty.
items.label: Visible field label.
items.labelPlacement: Label position: above or on the border.
items.helperText: Hint below the field (hidden when `errorMessage` is shown).
items.errorMessage: Error copy. Marks the field as invalid.
items.infoText: Shows an info icon with this content.
items.infoLabel: Accessible name of the info icon.
items.prefix: Content before the value: text, icon or any node.
items.suffix: Content after the value: text, icon or any node.
items.prefixIcon: Decorative icon before the value (shown before prefix).
items.suffixIcon: Decorative icon after the value (shown after suffix).
items.border: Border tone. Forced to error when the field is invalid.
items.validRegex: Pattern the value must match. Empty values count as valid.
items.uppercase: Forces typed text and the `onChange` value to uppercase.
items.isRequired: Marks the field as required (aria-required + asterisk).
items.wrapperClassName: Extra classes for the root container.
items.onValidate: Fires when validity changes (and on mount when `validRegex` is set).
items.onInfoClick: Fires when the info icon is activated.
